description: This file contains implementation code for network interface management, including platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems. It handles network interface enumeration, address modification, route management, and event notification within the WPEFramework Core namespace.
external_files: <POSIX-specific headers: arpa/inet.h, ifaddrs.h, net/if_arp.h, rtnetlink.h, list, net/if.h, netinet/in.h, sys/ioctl.h, sys/socket.h>

classes.name: IPNetworks
classes.description: Singleton class managing network interfaces and addresses, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network interface, providing methods to check status, enable/disable, and manage addresses and routes.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for enumerating network adapters and their properties.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observer class for monitoring network adapter events and status changes.

classes.name: IPNode
classes.description: Represents an IP address node, supporting IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Identifier for network nodes, supporting address types and masks.

methods.name: ConvertMACToString
methods.description: Converts a MAC address byte array to a string representation with delimiters.

methods.name: LoadAdapterInfo
methods.description: Loads network adapter information for a given adapter index, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: IPV4AddressIterator::Address
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv4 address at the current iterator position.

methods.name: IPV6AddressIterator::Address
methods.description: Retrieves the IPv6 address at the current iterator position.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of network adapters.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the current network adapter.

methods.name: AdapterIterator::MACAddress
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the current network adapter as a string.

methods.name: Network::IsUp
methods.description: Checks if the network interface is up and running.

methods.name: Network::Add
methods.description: Adds an IP address to the network interface.

methods.name: Network::Delete
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the network interface.

methods.name: Network::Gateway
methods.description: Sets a gateway for a network.
